_comment: The marathon plan. build.py validates it and writes it into the app as RUNPLAN. Minutes, not km. E = easy, Q = easy plus quality once earned, L = long. 'qq'/'lq' mark sessions with quality content, which the app only prescribes after 7 days without Amber or Red. Re-plans happen here, at a review, never in the app.

base.title: Base
base.goal: Easy running only. Build the habit and the tissue tolerance, not fitness.

build.title: Build
build.goal: Long run grows. Strides, then steady running, once the back has been quiet for a week.

specific.title: Specific
specific.goal: Marathon-effort running and the longest long runs. Run-walk on everything over 2 hours.

taper.title: Taper
taper.goal: Less volume, same rhythm. Gym at deload dosing.

race.title: Race week
race.goal: Short and easy. Nothing heavy in the gym after Wednesday.

text.E: Easy, talk-test pace (RPE 3-4). Flat and soft if you can.
text.Q_strides: Easy, then 6 x 20 s strides: relaxed, quick feet, full recovery. Not sprints.
text.Q_steady: 10 min easy, 3 x 8 min steady (RPE 6) with 2 min easy between, easy to finish.
text.Q_mp: 10 min easy, 2 x 15 min at marathon effort (RPE 5-6) with 3 min easy between, easy to finish.
text.L: Easy, talk-test pace. Soft surfaces where you can.
text.L_runwalk: Run-walk from the start: 9 min run, 1 min walk. Easy throughout.

weeks.note: Moved from week 12 to line up with rehab deload week 24.

weeks.l_text: Run-walk 9:1, then the last 20 min at marathon effort, running through.

weeks.q_text: 10K test: 15 min easy, 10 km steady-hard on a flat route, 10 min easy. Your time sets the race pace.

weeks.l_text: Run-walk 9:1, then the last 45 min at race pace and race run-walk. The dress rehearsal: race shoes, race breakfast, race gels.

weeks.e_text: 30 min easy, then 4 x 20 s strides.
weeks.q_text: Shakeout: 20 min very easy, two days before the race.

rules.t: The morning check-in decides the run
rules.b: Green: run as planned. Amber: easy only, 30 min cap, long run at 60%, flat soft route, no strides or steady work. Red, or anything below the knee: no run, walk only.
Settle: no running. Reintroduce: walk-run, 20 min max. Rebuild: half the planned minutes, long run 45 min max. Re-load: 75%, easy only. Full: 90%, easy only until the flare closes.
back pain climbs to 4 or more, or anything reaches below the knee. Log the run with that score; the next morning's check-in decides what happens next.
Only after 7 days with no Amber or Red. Otherwise the session is run easy at the same length.
The day after a long run of 90 min or more: Day B, not the hinge day. No heavy legs in the 48 h before a long run of 2 h or more. Cutback and taper weeks are gym deload weeks too.
Every long run of 2 h or more, and the race: 9 min run, 1 min walk, from the start. Walk breaks cut the continuous load on the spine, and finishing healthy does not need the minutes they cost.
The treadmill counts minute for minute for E and Q, at 1% incline. Keep the long run outside where you can. On ice, move it a day.

rules.t: A week is a set of runs
rules.b: Do the three runs in any order by Sunday. Suggested: Tue E, Thu Q, Sun L, with the gym on Mon, Wed and Fri. Never two runs on consecutive days if the back was Amber in between.

race_day: Morning check-in done. Amber: start, run-walk, and be ready to walk it in. Red or leg symptoms: do not start.
Run-walk 9:1 from the first kilometre, whatever everyone else does.
Gels every 40 min, the brand you used in the long runs.
Shoes that have at least two long runs in them.
Bib, pins, timing chip, and something warm to throw away at the start.
